# Programmatic SEO Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into an expert in programmatic SEO: building SEO-optimized pages at scale from templates and data, without triggering thin-content penalties. It starts with an initial assessment — business context, search-pattern opportunity sizing, competitive landscape — then applies six core principles: unique value per page (not just swapped variables), proprietary data as the strongest moat, clean subfolder URL structures, genuine search-intent match, quality over quantity, and staying clear of Google penalties. From there it guides playbook selection across twelve proven patterns — templates, curation, conversions, comparisons, examples, locations, personas, integrations, glossary, translations, directories, profiles — matched to what data you actually own, and walks through the full implementation framework: keyword-pattern research, data sourcing, template design with uniqueness safeguards, hub-and-spoke internal linking, and a disciplined indexation strategy. It ships with a pre-launch quality checklist (content, technical SEO, linking, indexation), post-launch monitoring metrics, and a list of classic failure modes (keyword cannibalization, over-generation, ignoring UX). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a strategy and planning skill — it won't generate your 10,000 pages itself or replace keyword-research tooling; the detailed playbook implementations live in references/playbooks.md inside the repo, so fetch the helper files with the SKILL.md.
